newsitem.title: CANADA: Antares Mining in C$24.9 mln warrant deal.
newsitem.headline: Antares Mining in C$24.9 mln warrant deal.

text.p: Antares Mining and Exploration Corp said on Friday it has agreed to a sale of special warrants on a bought-deal basis for gross proceeds of C$24.9 million.
Antares said it has signed an agreement with a group of underwriters who will purchase 7.46 million special warrants on a bought-deal basis at C$3.35 per warrant.
Each special warrant will be exchangeable into one common share of Antares, the company said in a statement.
To clear the share exchange, a prospectus will be filed within 120 days of closing of the warrant sale, Antares said.
The proceeds from the placement would be used to advance Antares' exploration program on the Ojolali gold and silver property in Sumatra, Indonesia, the company said.
Funds also would be used for acquisitions and working capital purposes.
Antares said negotiations were under way to increase its 24.75 percent stake in Rappa Holdings (Proprietary) Ltd, a gold recovery operation in South Africa.
